pending_items.title: Two supertankers hit mines near Hormuz, Iranian navy says
pending_items.content: Two supertankers hit mines near Hormuz, Iranian navy says Iran's navy said on Sunday that two supertankers hit naval mines and caught fire after entering a "restricted area" east of the Strait of Hormuz, Iranian media reported. According to the Fars news agency, the navy said the tankers had switched off their detection and navigation systems and struck the mines north of Ghanam Island. Both vessels reportedly stopped moving. Supertankers usually carry two million barrels of oil or more, about twice as much as a standard tanker. The navy also warned that relying on "smugglers such as CENTCOM", referring to US Central Command, would result in "nothing but heavy losses".
